g.text: A night: steps, deadlines and guards

text.style: text-anchor: start; fill: #c3c2b7; font: normal 400 8.5px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A scheduled task fires at 02:00. The guards run first, in order; past a deadline the whole process tree is killed.

g.text: A STOP file stops the night at any check. A busy model port or a running engine process means the night doesn't start.
